title: Part number
description: The number of a part, written large by hand on a cut-paper shape taped onto the kraft: a disc, a scalloped disc (cut with pinking shears) or a star.
instructions: One per part opener, in the side slot of a split sheet. number is short (« 1 », « 2 », « A »). Pick another shape and paper for each part; keep to the light papers, the number stays in ink.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: The paper shape under the number.

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: The colour of the shape (a theme token). The number stays in ink: keep to the light papers.
